name: Release date differs
rule: Zip name date is not 20260906.
why_it_matters: Mixing monthly releases leaves differences nobody can trace.

name: Member file date inconsistent with zip date
rule: A CSV member name's date is not the zip date or the next day (20260906 or 20260907).
why_it_matters: A member from another run would mean the zip mixes snapshots.

name: Header differs from FY2025
rule: The CSV header is not exactly FY2025's 297 column names in the same order.
why_it_matters: Columns that move or change name break every cross-year comparison.

name: Malformed records
rule: Any record whose field count is not 297, or any csv parse error (Stage 1 proof).
why_it_matters: A malformed record can shift values into the wrong columns.

name: Blank lines in a member
rule: Any blank line in a CSV member (counted in the Stage 1 proof; never a row).
why_it_matters: Harmless once counted, but a sign of an unusual file.

name: Transaction key blank
rule: contract_transaction_unique_key is empty or whitespace only.
why_it_matters: The key identifies the transaction; a blank key cannot be traced or deduplicated.

name: Transaction key repeated within the year
rule: contract_transaction_unique_key appears on more than one row of the same fiscal year file (every such row is flagged).
why_it_matters: Double counting of obligations.

name: Transaction key in more than one fiscal year
rule: contract_transaction_unique_key appears in more than one fiscal year's file (every such row is flagged).
why_it_matters: A transaction should appear in exactly one year; otherwise cross-year totals double count.
fy2015_handling: FY2015 is pending (not yet downloaded): comparisons that would need FY2015 are skipped and reported as skipped, never flagged.

name: Exact duplicate row
rule: Another row in the same fiscal year has identical values in all 297 fields (full-row MD5 equal).
why_it_matters: Pure duplication of a record.

name: Award spans several fiscal years
rule: contract_award_unique_key appears in more than one fiscal year's file (counted per award, not per row).
why_it_matters: Normal for multi-year contracts; matters for how awards are counted per year.
fy2015_handling: FY2015 is pending (not yet downloaded): comparisons that would need FY2015 are skipped and reported as skipped, never flagged.

name: Award key prefix disagrees with award/IDV flag
rule: contract_award_unique_key starts with CONT_AWD_ but award_or_idv_flag is not AWARD, or starts with CONT_IDV_ but the flag is not IDV, or starts with neither.
why_it_matters: Award-level and IDV-level rows are treated differently in the analysis.

name: Action date outside its file's fiscal year
rule: action_date parses but is before Oct 1 of (FY-1) or after Sep 30 of FY.
why_it_matters: The row would be counted in the wrong year.

name: Fiscal year column disagrees with the file
rule: action_date_fiscal_year is not the file's fiscal year.
why_it_matters: Year assignment is ambiguous.

name: Action date missing or invalid
rule: action_date is blank, not YYYY-MM-DD, or not a real calendar date.
why_it_matters: Rows without a usable date drop out of any date-filtered analysis.

name: Other date unparseable
rule: A non-blank value in period_of_performance_start_date, period_of_performance_current_end_date, period_of_performance_potential_end_date, ordering_period_end_date, solicitation_date (YYYY-MM-DD, optionally followed by a time of day HH:MM:SS) or initial_report_date, last_modified_date (timestamp) does not parse as a real date/time. [Revised 2026-10-05 after a first run on FY2023-FY2025: the original rule required YYYY-MM-DD for every date column, but period_of_performance_potential_end_date is stored as 'YYYY-MM-DD 00:00:00' in the archive, so ~95% of rows were flagged by a wrong format assumption. No threshold changed.]
why_it_matters: Unparseable dates hide timing information.

name: Implausible date
rule: Any of the date columns above parses to a date before 1900-01-01 or after 2100-12-31. (Same parsing as C04.)
why_it_matters: Typo-like dates distort durations and lags.

name: Performance period starts after it ends
rule: period_of_performance_start_date > period_of_performance_current_end_date (both valid).
why_it_matters: Inconsistent contract timing.

name: Reported more than 90 days after the action
rule: initial_report_date (as a date) minus action_date > 90 days.
why_it_matters: Late reporting means recent years are still filling in (DoD has a 90-day lag by policy).

name: Reported before the action date
rule: initial_report_date (as a date) is earlier than action_date.
why_it_matters: Most gaps are short (median 3 to 4 days in FY2010 and FY2024), which fits actions entered a few days before their effective date. Long gaps can still be date-entry errors.
changelog: 2026-10-05, after seeing the data (version 2 review): why_it_matters rewritten to match the evidence. Version 1 text: 'A report cannot precede the action; points to a date entry error.' Rule, threshold and severity unchanged.

name: Action date after the release date
rule: action_date is after 2026-09-06.
why_it_matters: Future-dated actions cannot be real as of this snapshot.

name: Last modified before the action date
rule: last_modified_date (as a date) is earlier than action_date.
why_it_matters: Record history is inconsistent.

name: Obligation blank
rule: federal_action_obligation is empty.
why_it_matters: A row with no amount cannot be summed.

name: Obligation unparseable
rule: federal_action_obligation is not a number (fails DECIMAL(38,6)).
why_it_matters: Dollar totals would silently lose it.

name: Obligation with more than 2 decimal places
rule: federal_action_obligation has more than 2 digits after the decimal point.
why_it_matters: Cents are the reporting unit; extra precision points to a data entry or conversion issue.

name: IDV row carries dollars
rule: award_or_idv_flag = IDV and federal_action_obligation is non-zero.
why_it_matters: Team decision pending on whether IDV-level obligations count (the pilot found $14.7B in FY2025).

name: Placeholder vendor
rule: recipient_name (trimmed, upper case) is MULTIPLE RECIPIENTS, MISCELLANEOUS FOREIGN AWARDEES, MISCELLANEOUS FOREIGN CONTRACTORS, UNKNOWN, UNKNOWN VENDOR, N/A, NA, NONE, NULL, or REDACTED (any value starting REDACTED).
why_it_matters: Concentration measures must not treat a placeholder as a real firm.

name: Placeholder ID
rule: recipient_uei, recipient_parent_uei, recipient_duns or recipient_parent_duns is all zeros, all nines, or one of the placeholder words listed for E03.
why_it_matters: A shared fake ID would merge unrelated vendors.

name: Placeholder-looking values (profile)
rule: For every column: the share of values that, trimmed and upper-cased, equal UNKNOWN, UNK, N/A, NA, N\A, NONE, NULL, NIL, NAN, -, --, ., ?, TBD, NOT APPLICABLE, NOT AVAILABLE, MISSING, MULTIPLE RECIPIENTS, MISCELLANEOUS FOREIGN AWARDEES, MISCELLANEOUS FOREIGN CONTRACTORS, or start with REDACTED; plus, for columns whose name ends in _code, _uei or _duns, all-zero values of 2+ characters. Profile only (no row flag); NONE is a real code in some columns, so this is descriptive.
why_it_matters: Shows where blanks are disguised as values.

name: Leading/trailing whitespace and case variants (profile)
rule: For every column: values matching regex ^\s|\s$, and the number of distinct values that differ only by case after trimming.
why_it_matters: Whitespace and case variants split one value into several groups.

name: Blank share (profile)
rule: For every column and year: the share of rows that are empty or whitespace only; and for numeric-looking columns the share equal to zero.
why_it_matters: Coverage of every field, by year.

name: PSC not 4 characters
rule: product_or_service_code is non-blank and not ^[A-Z0-9]{4}$.
why_it_matters: PSC is the product dimension of the concentration analysis.

name: NAICS not 6 digits
rule: naics_code is non-blank and not ^[0-9]{6}$.
why_it_matters: NAICS is an alternative industry dimension.

name: UEI not 12 characters
rule: recipient_uei or recipient_parent_uei is non-blank and not ^[A-Z0-9]{12}$.
why_it_matters: Vendor and parent identity depend on clean IDs.

name: DUNS not 9 digits
rule: recipient_duns or recipient_parent_duns is non-blank and not ^[0-9]{9}$.
why_it_matters: Pre-2022 vendor identity depends on DUNS.

name: Agency code not 3 characters
rule: awarding_agency_code or funding_agency_code is non-blank and not ^[0-9A-Z]{3}$.
why_it_matters: USAspending's API documentation says a top-tier agency code could be a CGAC or a FREC code, which have 3 and 4 characters. A 4-character code is valid. It matters only if one agency appears under both kinds of code (F10).
changelog: 2026-10-05, after seeing the data (version 2 review): severity changed from review to info, and why_it_matters rewritten. Version 1: severity review, 286,312 rows flagged; why_it_matters was 'Agency is the market definition's first dimension.' Rule unchanged.

name: Sub-agency code not 4 characters
rule: awarding_sub_agency_code or funding_sub_agency_code is non-blank and not ^[0-9A-Z]{4}$.
why_it_matters: Sub-agency markets.

name: Code with more than one label in a year
rule: Within one fiscal year, a code in a code/label column pair has more than one distinct non-blank label. Pairs: every column ending _code paired with the first existing of <base>_name, <base>, <base>_description, <code column>_description.
why_it_matters: Labels that disagree within a year make grouping by name unreliable.

name: Code whose label changes across years
rule: The same code has different modal labels in different fiscal years (same pairs as F07).
why_it_matters: Feeds the agency name-change crosswalk.
fy2015_handling: FY2015 is pending (not yet downloaded): comparisons that would need FY2015 are skipped and reported as skipped, never flagged.

name: Offers received not a whole number
rule: number_of_offers_received is non-blank and not ^[0-9]+$.
why_it_matters: Competition measure.

name: Agency under both a 3- and a 4-character code
rule: An agency name (trimmed, upper case) appears with at least one 3-character code and at least one 4-character code in the same column pair (awarding_agency_code with awarding_agency_name, or funding_agency_code with funding_agency_name) across all present years.
why_it_matters: One agency split across two codes would be measured as two markets.
changelog: 2026-10-05, added after seeing the data (version 2 review), following the F05 severity change. Not part of the catalog committed before the first run.

name: Order without a parent award
rule: award_type_code is A (BPA call) or C (delivery order) and parent_award_id_piid is blank.
why_it_matters: Orders should hang from an IDV; missing links break award roll-ups.

name: Definitive contract or purchase order with a parent award
rule: award_type_code is B (purchase order) or D (definitive contract) and parent_award_id_piid is non-blank.
why_it_matters: Unexpected parent links can mis-assign awards.

name: Code and label disagree on presence
rule: For the main pairs (awarding/funding agency, sub-agency, office, PSC, NAICS, award type, IDV type, extent competed, set-aside, pricing): the code is blank but the label is not, or the label is blank but the code is not.
why_it_matters: Half-filled code/label pairs signal entry or mapping errors.

name: Recipient UEI with many names in one year
rule: A recipient_uei has 5 or more distinct recipient_name values (trimmed, upper case) within one fiscal year.
why_it_matters: Possible ID reuse or naming chaos; affects vendor identity.

name: Parent UEI with many parent names in one year
rule: A recipient_parent_uei has 5 or more distinct recipient_parent_name values (trimmed, upper case) within one fiscal year (recipient_parent_name_raw profiled alongside).
why_it_matters: Parent roll-up depends on a stable parent identity.

name: Thin month (rows)
rule: A month's row count is below 50% of the median monthly row count of the same fiscal year. September being high is normal and not flagged.
why_it_matters: Missing or late-loaded months make a year look smaller.

name: Thin month (dollars)
rule: A month's net obligations are below 50% of the median monthly net obligations of the same fiscal year.
why_it_matters: Same, in dollars.

name: Agency missing in a middle year
rule: An awarding agency code with rows in some earlier and some later present year has no rows in a present year between them.
why_it_matters: A missing agency-year breaks trends and concentration series.
fy2015_handling: FY2015 is pending (not yet downloaded): comparisons that would need FY2015 are skipped and reported as skipped, never flagged. A gap at FY2015 alone is not flagged.

name: Agency drop that recovers (dollars)
rule: An awarding agency's net obligations fall below 20% of the previous year's (a drop of more than 80%) and the next year is back to at least 50% of the pre-drop year; applies only when the pre-drop year is at least $10,000,000.
why_it_matters: A one-year collapse that recovers is more likely a data gap than a real change.
fy2015_handling: FY2015 is pending (not yet downloaded): comparisons that would need FY2015 are skipped and reported as skipped, never flagged.

name: Agency drop that recovers (rows)
rule: Same as H04 using row counts; applies only when the pre-drop year has at least 1,000 rows.
why_it_matters: Same, in rows.
fy2015_handling: FY2015 is pending (not yet downloaded): comparisons that would need FY2015 are skipped and reported as skipped, never flagged.

name: Sub-agency missing in a middle year
rule: As H03 for awarding sub-agency codes.
why_it_matters: Sub-agency markets.
fy2015_handling: FY2015 is pending (not yet downloaded): comparisons that would need FY2015 are skipped and reported as skipped, never flagged. A gap at FY2015 alone is not flagged.

name: Sub-agency drop that recovers (dollars)
rule: As H04 for awarding sub-agency codes (pre-drop year at least $10,000,000).
why_it_matters: Sub-agency markets.
fy2015_handling: FY2015 is pending (not yet downloaded): comparisons that would need FY2015 are skipped and reported as skipped, never flagged.

name: Sub-agency drop that recovers (rows)
rule: As H05 for awarding sub-agency codes (pre-drop year at least 1,000 rows).
why_it_matters: Sub-agency markets.
fy2015_handling: FY2015 is pending (not yet downloaded): comparisons that would need FY2015 are skipped and reported as skipped, never flagged.

name: ID and analysis-field coverage (profile)
rule: By year: share of rows and of gross dollars blank in recipient_uei, recipient_duns, recipient_parent_uei, recipient_parent_duns, product_or_service_code, extent_competed_code, number_of_offers_received, type_of_set_aside_code, parent_award_id_piid.
why_it_matters: Shows which years can support which analysis (DUNS-to-UEI switch April 2022).

name: Gap to published total: WARN
rule: |our net total - published figure| / published figure is more than 2% and at most 10% (independent nominal figures only).
why_it_matters: May point to missing data or a definition difference.

name: Gap to published total: FAIL
rule: |our net total - published figure| / published figure is more than 10% (independent nominal figures only).
why_it_matters: Large gaps need an explanation before the year is used.

name: Top 100 by absolute amount
rule: The 100 rows of the fiscal year with the largest |federal_action_obligation| (ties broken by key).
why_it_matters: The rows that move totals most deserve a look.

name: Transaction of $1 billion or more
rule: |federal_action_obligation| >= 1,000,000,000.
why_it_matters: Single huge actions dominate concentration measures.

name: Deobligation larger than the award's obligations that year
rule: federal_action_obligation < 0 and its absolute value exceeds the sum of positive federal_action_obligation on the same contract_award_unique_key in the same fiscal year file.
why_it_matters: Negative-net awards in a year; affects award-level totals.

name: Amount far from its peers
rule: Within agency (awarding_agency_code) x PSC first character x fiscal year groups of at least 20 non-zero rows: robust z = (log10|amount| - median) / (1.4826 x MAD) and |z| > 5; groups with MAD = 0 are skipped.
why_it_matters: Possible misplaced decimal points or unit errors. Amounts on round numbers can be legitimate.

name: Whitespace around a key or code
rule: contract_transaction_unique_key, contract_award_unique_key, award_id_piid, parent_award_id_piid, any *_code or *_uei or *_duns column used in F01-F06 has leading or trailing whitespace (regex ^\s|\s$).
why_it_matters: Invisible characters split IDs into different groups.

name: Zero offers on a competed action
rule: number_of_offers_received is exactly 0 and extent_competed_code is A (full and open), D (full and open after exclusion of sources), F (competed under simplified acquisition) or CDO (competitive delivery order).
why_it_matters: A competed action with zero offers is contradictory; it distorts competition measures.
